many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def objects(g):
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen and g[r][c]!=2:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    x,y=stack.pop()
                    if (x,y) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((x,y)); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and g[nx][ny]==col and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                            stack.append((nx,ny))
                objs.append(cells)
    return objs

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bar row
    bar=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==2 for c in range(W))]
    br=bar[0]
    dirn = -1 if br==0 else 1  # objects fall toward bar
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    out[br]=[2]*W
    objs=objects(g)
    if dirn==-1:
        objs.sort(key=lambda o: min(r for r,c in o))
    else:
        objs.sort(key=lambda o: -max(r for r,c in o))
    for cells in objs:
        col=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        # move up/down step by step
        while True:
            newc=[(r+dirn,c) for r,c in cells]
            ok=all(0<=r<H and out[r][c]==0 for r,c in newc)
            if ok: cells=newc
            else: break
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=col
    return out
